summary: Frontend-only test of Knowledge Hub feature for Lily's text-based auto-reply. Verified all 4 spec calculation examples (288% RM100, 188 FS deposit 500, below-min, welcome_100_100 RM50), no-amount matcher, exclusion line derivation for all 3 promos, matcher disambiguation (welcome bonus 100 percent → welcome_100_100), Lily-stage persistence after KB reply, and unmatched-text handoff fallback. Also ran 35/35 node unit tests for knowledgeHub.js. All tests pass.

e2e_widget_tests.2d_welcome100_RM50: PASS (Bonus MYR 50.00, Free spins 100, Turnover MYR 1,800.00)
e2e_widget_tests.4a_288pct_exclusion_exact: PASS (Pussy888, PlayTech, Asia Gaming, Relax Gaming, Mega888, 918kiss, Habanero, BNG, Lucky365)
e2e_widget_tests.4b_welcome100_exclusion_exact: PASS (918kiss, Mega888, fishing games, table games, online games)
e2e_widget_tests.6_disambiguation: PASS ('welcome bonus 100 percent' → Welcome Bonus 100% + 100 Free Spins)
e2e_widget_tests.7_unmatched_handoff: PASS (functionally — queued UI (#2) shown, lily-stage removed; the message log is replaced by the queue view so the 'connecting you to a human agent' string is not in the DOM afterwards, but handoffToHuman() did run and phase transitioned as expected)

not_directly_exercised_but_code_reviewed: Test 5 (guided Promotions Step 3 detail exclusion insertion) — code review of ChatWidget.jsx lines 728-738 confirms formatExclusionLine(p) is inserted between detailClosingParagraph and relatedArticlesHeader (only when non-empty). Backed by unit tests for formatExclusionLine on all 3 promos.

Test 8 (existing guided promo flow keyword matcher precedence) — code review of sendMessage() Lily branch (lines 834-865) confirms activePromoId is checked BEFORE the KB fallback runs; KB only fires in the else branch.
Existing quick options (Deposit/Withdrawal/Ticket/Promotions) — untouched code paths, hit earlier click handlers.

critical_code_review_comments: knowledgeHub.js is a clean, self-contained module (~430 lines) with data + engine + matcher + formatter. Good separation.
ChatWidget.jsx is 1686 lines — recommend splitting (guided promotions, KB fallback, WS handling, quick-options) into hooks/subcomponents in a future iteration. Not blocking.
matchKnowledgeHub uses longest-keyword-hit scoring — verified deterministic via 'welcome bonus 100 percent' disambiguation test.
extractDepositAmount correctly strips % tokens BEFORE bare-number fallback, so '288%' alone doesn't get misread as deposit 288. Confirmed.

formatExclusionLine is derived from promo.excluded_games at render time in every surface (KB reply generalTermsBlock + guided Step 3 detail bubble) — no hardcoded lists. Verified all three exact lists appear in the widget.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Widget mounts at / (WidgetDemo page); /widget route does not exist and redirects to /. Open the floating FAB button to expose the chat. chat-input testid is present once the widget is open. saySystem has a 500ms typing-dots delay — wait ≥1.2s between sends for KB replies to appear. Handoff transitions the widget to the queued view which REPLACES the message log with a 'You're in the queue #N' UI, so post-handoff assertions on log body text won't find the handoff message — assert on lily-stage removal instead.
